title: Public S3 bucket exposes data exports
description: Bucket pii-exports is publicly accessible to the internet via a public-read bucket policy.
remediation_hint: Enable S3 Block Public Access at the account and bucket level.

title: IAM role trusts a wildcard principal with Action: *
description: Role ci-runner grants Action: * on Resource: * and is overly permissive.
remediation_hint: Scope the role's inline policy to the specific actions it needs.

title: Security group opens SSH to the world
description: Security group sg-0native allows unrestricted ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22.
remediation_hint: Restrict SSH ingress to known admin CIDRs.

title: KMS key rotation disabled
description: Automatic key rotation is not enabled for the customer managed key.
